action_ideas: Conduct a comprehensive user experience audit of the portfolio view, including usability testing and heatmap analysis, to identify and address the key pain points reported by users. Implement a responsive and customizable portfolio layout with the ability to resize and rearrange elements.

Develop a roadmap to enhance the app's charting and trading capabilities, including the ability to view index and option charts together, as well as the addition of advanced trading features like trailing stop-loss, partial exit, and quick exit options. Prioritize these features based on customer feedback and competitive analysis.

Investigate the root causes of the reported performance and technical issues, and implement a robust quality assurance process to ensure consistent app performance and reliable order execution. Conduct thorough testing, optimize the codebase, and establish clear communication channels with customers to address any future technical problems.
